gitCommit.subject: Align responsive web UI with mobile app parity at <768px.
gitCommit.body:
Align responsive web UI with mobile app parity at <768px.

Add mobile shell (forms, dashboard, finances, profile sheet, bottom nav flex layout), native-style date pickers and picker sheets, auth logo fix on light backgrounds, and Playwright mobile-web e2e plus desktop spec scoping for dual-DOM pages.

specs.title: authenticate
user archives their account from profile danger zone
archived user cannot log back in
same email can be reused for a fresh signup after archive
unauthenticated visit redirects to sign in
redirects to pricing when ASSISTANT_WEB_ENABLED is off
empty state shows the 9 suggestion chips
tapping a suggestion chip renders a deterministic reply with markdown bold
conversation history list renders the just-created conversation
FAB opens, history toggles, Escape closes both
logout redirects back to sign in
wrong credentials stay on login page
bank accounts list and new form are reachable
dashboard renders key sections
unauthenticated visit redirects to sign in
renders the recurring index page or redirects when subscription gate denies
'New recurring' link routes to the form
Transactions page shows 'Recurrentes' tab and navigates correctly
renders the canonical detail layout for a newly created series
end → reactivate flow on a cancelled series
sidebar link navigates to /settings and all three sections render
analytics opt-out toggle persists across reload
feedback rows use mailto: support@vitt.io with proper subject prefixes
Eliminar cuenta routes to /profile/confirm_delete
/profile no longer shows the Danger Zone (moved to /settings)
disclosure is collapsed by default on a plain new transaction
create transaction with items and tax saves and shows badge on list
edit: disclosure auto-opens and items are pre-populated
add and remove items round-trip correctly
plain transaction without items keeps disclosure collapsed on edit
cleanup: delete the e2e items transaction
manual income transaction creation works
manual expense transaction creation works
manual transfer transaction creation works
transactions filters and sorting work in key journeys
transactions CSV export downloads and includes expected data
inline category edit routes saves to the correct row (singleton panel)
transaction can be deleted from table actions
dashboard shows mobile shell and pinned bottom nav
bottom nav navigates to transactions
recurring new form renders mobile shell with date picker row
transaction new form renders mobile shell
settings renders mobile sections and footer actions
profile renders mobile edit form
category new form renders mobile shell
statement upload renders mobile shell
